truthDomain: companion presence and companion state routing

ash_remediation_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_remediation_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream modules and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
ash_remediation_contract.engine_contract_rule: Module activation and service entrypoints must reject meaningful companion state requests that lack CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, and GenerationPlan provenance.

entrypoint_requirements.DiagnosticEnvelope: required for validity, fallback, no-op, and recovery semantics

purpose: Declares the Companion Engine service contract for persistent Raven Companion state, conditional wolf manifestation events, and companion reward delta routing.

methods.name: validate_companion_engine_contract
methods.description: Validate Companion Engine activation against Forsetti lifecycle rules and ASH provenance requirements.

methods.name: resolve_raven_companion_state
methods.description: Resolve persistent Raven Companion state from player runtime state and source provenance.

methods.name: resolve_wolf_manifestation_event
methods.description: Resolve a conditional wolf manifestation event from trigger, duration, and source-reference evidence.

methods.name: route_companion_reward_delta
methods.description: Route companion-safe reward deltas without direct companion state mutation.

invariants: Module engine interface fields must satisfy Forsetti Framework Compliance checks.
CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, and GenerationPlan provenance is required before meaningful companion state interpretation.
The module must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
The Raven Companion remains persistent player runtime state.
Wolf presence requires a conditional manifestation event.
